findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_forecaster_record" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_probabilities, submit_forecast · Private data: research_market, submit_forecast, get_forecaster_record · Public sink: submit_forecast.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_probabilities, submit_forecast · Private data: research_market, submit_forecast, get_forecaster_record · Public sink: submit_forecast

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
